name: Doorman
slug: The Doorman is Gerk's unique keeper role, able to open and close an Arch and create seamless doorways that bend reality.
description: The Doorman is a unique keeper role held by Gerk, distinct from the Gatekeeper roles held by the other party members. The Doorman has the ability to open and close an Arch, connect with and protect it, and manipulate reality to create doorways through an invisible handle. These doorways have no conventional threshold and bend reality seamlessly, allowing passage between locations. The destinations of Gerk’s doorways are currently unpredictable.

log.summary: The Doorman role was established as distinct from the other party members’ Gatekeeper roles, granting Gerk the unique ability to open, close, connect with, and protect an Arch. Gerk demonstrated this power by manipulating an invisible handle to create a seamless doorway through reality, without a conventional threshold. His first demonstrated doorway led to an unknown beach on Midgard, though the destinations of his portals are currently unpredictable.
notes: The Doorman is distinct from the Gatekeeper roles held by the other party members.
